description.en: Reconstructive recall enhancer for DeepSeek Harness: reads the memory stores of existing memory plugins (16 built-in adapters incl. dsh-prime-memory, dsh-mnemon, dsh-loci, dsh-memory-palace), fuses multiple stores with RRF in auto mode, and before each model step rebuilds retrieved memory fragments into contextual, emotionally-toned recollection snippets instead of raw-text injection.
description.zh: 重建式回忆增强插件：只读现有记忆插件的记忆库（内置 16 种主流记忆源适配，含 dsh-prime-memory、dsh-mnemon、dsh-loci、dsh-memory-palace 等），auto 模式下多库 RRF 融合，在模型步骤前把检索到的记忆碎片「重建」为带语境与情绪的回忆片段注入，替代生硬的原文注入。
